scope: Actual PopupKeyboardUi, unattached measure/layout/draw; direct public changeFocus with trigger-local coordinates and onTrigger only. No InputDispatcher, long-press/IME, TalkBack, native session, Chinese input or physical-device acceptance.
test_context: ContextThemeWrapper(targetContext, R.style.Theme_TrimeAppTheme); harness AppCompat theme, not a claimed production IME context or theme-warning fix
vertical_policy: Existing drag bias is intentionally preserved. X-center at measured cell.top + 0.85*height is an existing row-activation area, NOT geometric center. Y-center mismatch is not fixed or counted as this repair.
scope_restore_limit: Original scope null cannot be restored through public API; test scope remains only in this isolated target process. Root must stop the process after collecting evidence.
